en: A Czech postal stationery card with printed stamp and special Olympic-themed cancellation. The left side shows a red line drawing of a historic clock tower building, with a blue emblem of Europe and Olympic rings below. Nearby red text commemorates the 16th seminar of general secretaries and mission chiefs of the E.O.C. The upper right has a printed 3 Kč Czech Republic postage stamp depicting a small village scene with houses, church and trees, and is postmarked with a circular cancellation from Praha dated 21.9.1995. The right half of the card has typical postcard address lines and barcode marks.
